title: [DEMO] Add Mandelbrot set endpoint to fractal API
description:
## Acceptance Criteria
- GET /mandelbrot returns a valid Mandelbrot set fractal
- endpoint accepts iterations, width, height, xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax parameters
- input is validated (iterations clamped 1-100, dimensions 100-800)
- all existing tests still pass (6/6 including new ones)
- ruff lint reports zero errors
- no critical security findings

## Agents
- repo_inspector
- test_pyramid
- security
- lint
- code_quality
